provenance.subset_rationale: Documented subset = the 5 of 10 corpus cases that reproduce the published parquet goldens within the upstream manifest tolerance (rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-14) under our pinned env (aggregate 2.1.0, numpy 2.2.5, scipy 1.18.1, pandas 2.3.3, python 3.12). The other 5 cases (Tail.LN, Re.Both, Mixture, Port.CNC, Port.Bounded) show FFT/scipy-version-sensitive deltas in our env; measured divergences are documented in f1-report.md.

Base.FixedOne.program: agg Base.FixedOne 1 claim sev lognorm 100 cv 0.5 fixed

Base.DfreqOne.program: agg Base.DfreqOne dfreq [1] sev lognorm 100 cv 0.5

Def.Pareto.program: agg Def.Pareto 1 claim sev 1000 * pareto 1.5 - 1000 fixed

Port.Bodoff.program: port Port.Bodoff agg wind  1 claim sev dhistogram xps [0,  99] [0.80, 0.20] fixed agg quake 1 claim sev dhistogram xps [0, 100] [0.95, 0.05] fixed
